# TGACH & dvachbot — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> TGACH (dvachbot) — Высокопроизводительная гибридная платформа имиджборд с двусторонней синхронизацией тредов через WebSockets и официального Telegram-бота @dvach_Chatbot.

## Official Live Production Endpoints
- Web Platform: https://tgach.top
- Official Telegram Bot: https://t.me/dvach_Chatbot (@dvach_Chatbot)
- Showcase & Interactive Lab: https://marko1olo.github.io/dvachbot/
- GitHub Source: https://github.com/marko1olo/dvachbot

## Architecture & Tech Stack
- Backend: Python 3.10+, FastAPI (ASGI), asyncio, aiofiles, Jinja2 Server-Side Rendering
- Real-time Sync: High-concurrency WebSockets connecting web clients with Telegram groups and channels
- Telegram Bot: Telethon / python-telegram-bot with automatic WebM -> WebP/MP4 transcoding and Floyd-Steinberg / Atkinson dithering
- Database: SQLite in WAL mode with FTS5 sub-millisecond full-text search indexing
